values.value: Finds: Active SBQQ__ApprovalRule__c records with no Approver and no ApproverField set. Why it matters: Quotes matching this rule trigger approval but have nobody to route to. The approval enters a stuck state, the quote can't progress to Order, and your sales cycle stalls — often invisibly until a deal is days late. Suppress a finding: when the rule is a placeholder waiting on a hire (e.g. "VP of Finance" not yet filled). Note the expected hire date and dismiss. Disable the detector: only if your org uses Advanced Approvals — where Approver is set on Approval Chain steps instead — and the legacy SBQQ__ApprovalRule__c records are intentionally empty.
